mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_agent_timeline_item ( session_id, run_id, item_id, parent_item_id, agent_id, kind, phase, status, order_key, sub_order, updated_seq, source_type, llm_invocation_id, tool_invocation_id, artifact_id, create_time, update_time, deleted ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{runId}, #{itemId}, #{parentItemId}, #{agentId}, #{kind}, #{phase}, #{status}, #{orderKey}, #{subOrder}, #{updatedSeq}, #{sourceType}, #{llmInvocationId}, #{toolInvocationId}, #{artifactId}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE parent_item_id = COALESCE(#{parentItemId}, parent_item_id), agent_id = COALESCE(agent_id, #{agentId}), kind = kind, phase = CASE WHEN phase = 'FINAL' OR #{phase} = 'FINAL' THEN 'FINAL' WHEN phase = 'SUMMARY' OR #{phase} = 'SUMMARY' THEN 'SUMMARY' ELSE #{phase} END, status = CASE WHEN status IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'FAILED') THEN status WHEN #{status} IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'FAILED') THEN #{status} WHEN #{updatedSeq} = 0 OR #{updatedSeq} >= updated_seq THEN #{status} ELSE status END, order_key = CASE WHEN order_key = 0 THEN #{orderKey} ELSE order_key END, sub_order = CASE WHEN sub_order = 0 THEN #{subOrder} ELSE sub_order END, updated_seq = GREATEST(updated_seq, #{updatedSeq}), source_type = source_type, llm_invocation_id = COALESCE(#{llmInvocationId}, llm_invocation_id), tool_invocation_id = COALESCE(#{toolInvocationId}, tool_invocation_id), artifact_id = COALESCE(#{artifactId}, artifact_id), update_time = NOW(), deleted = 0

INSERT INTO ai_agent_timeline_item ( session_id, run_id, item_id, parent_item_id, agent_id, kind, phase, status, order_key, sub_order, updated_seq, source_type, llm_invocation_id, tool_invocation_id, artifact_id, create_time, update_time, deleted ) VALUES
( #{item.sessionId}, #{item.runId}, #{item.itemId}, #{item.parentItemId}, #{item.agentId}, #{item.kind}, #{item.phase}, #{item.status}, #{item.orderKey}, #{item.subOrder}, #{item.updatedSeq}, #{item.sourceType}, #{item.llmInvocationId}, #{item.toolInvocationId}, #{item.artifactId}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE parent_item_id = COALESCE(VALUES(parent_item_id), parent_item_id), agent_id = COALESCE(agent_id, VALUES(agent_id)), kind = kind, phase = CASE WHEN phase = 'FINAL' OR VALUES(phase) = 'FINAL' THEN 'FINAL' WHEN phase = 'SUMMARY' OR VALUES(phase) = 'SUMMARY' THEN 'SUMMARY' ELSE VALUES(phase) END, status = CASE WHEN status IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'FAILED') THEN status WHEN VALUES(status) IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'FAILED') THEN VALUES(status) WHEN VALUES(updated_seq) = 0 OR VALUES(updated_seq) >= updated_seq THEN VALUES(status) ELSE status END, order_key = CASE WHEN order_key = 0 THEN VALUES(order_key) ELSE order_key END, sub_order = CASE WHEN sub_order = 0 THEN VALUES(sub_order) ELSE sub_order END, updated_seq = GREATEST(updated_seq, VALUES(updated_seq)), source_type = source_type, llm_invocation_id = COALESCE(VALUES(llm_invocation_id), llm_invocation_id), tool_invocation_id = COALESCE(VALUES(tool_invocation_id), tool_invocation_id), artifact_id = COALESCE(VALUES(artifact_id), artifact_id), update_time = NOW(), deleted = 0
